title: Decoupled-DMD loss decomposition: our objective is only DMD's guidance half
summary: User directed deriving extra loss terms via decoupled-DMD decomposition (rejected frequency). Derived: full DMD toward styled dist s_s-s_fake = (A) s_s-s_0 [our current score residual, a CFG-type conditional contrast] + (B) s_0-s_fake [real-fake distribution match, MISSING]. In x0-space the point-mass fake swaps static content baseline x̂0^0 for moving current prediction x̂0^cur: full = x̂0^s - x̂0^cur (detached). Advisor: must be COMBINED form, not A+βB (term B alone fights style).
why: Explains why texture dies (A cancels shared structure; texture info not in the conditional contrast) and why score_carrier/ca_only inert (all term-A). (B) injects real-manifold texture info frequency reweighting cannot.
alternatives: frequency decomp (rejected); Gram bolt-on (rejected); arms: point-mass moving-baseline (first), offline-warmed critic (gated), frozen-teacher fake (null by construction)
impact: Instrumented runner (DUMP_XHAT_STEPS, env-gated) for advisor's ceiling check (is texture in x̂0^s at all?). Ceiling driver headroom-gated + queued behind 4 external GPU jobs. Full plan in docs/research/LOSS_DECOMPOSITION.md.

Since A+B=s_s−s_fake and the fake score only moves the baseline (not s_s), texture must come from s_s and it is ABSENT. => no fake score / DMD / frequency / Gram on this conditioning path can rescue these failures.

title: CDM L_CA low-τ re-noise = NULL; same-state CA driver is the real win
summary: Implemented CDM L_CA (Rec1/3): evaluate the ca_only CA contrast at a re-noised LOW τ (tau_frac<1) with state-consistent implied ε (survey correctness fix over fresh randn). title: DM/fake-score UNNECESSARY: CA-alone stable to cfg20 (no collapse) in training-free inference
summary: DM-gate: pushed CA to cfg15/20 on style04/16 looking for the over-saturation/checkerboard collapse that decoupled-DMD's DM-shield exists to prevent. Result: cfg7≈15≈20 near-identical, ZERO artifacts even at cfg20. The collapse is a TRAINING (generator-distillation) phenomenon; 25-step single-latent inference never enters it. => no fake net, no shield, no re-noise needed — the CA driver alone is the method. Also re-confirms alpha-invariance => the rms-norm/extrapolation mechanism.
